title: PAX3::FOXO1-Targeting PROTAC Induces Myogenic Differentiation of Fusion-Positive Rhabdomyosarcoma Cells.
final_rationale: PAX3::FOXO1-targeting PROTAC caused concentration-, time-, and proteasome-dependent degradation of endogenous fusion protein.

title: A SIRT7-dependent acetylation switch regulates early B cell differentiation and lineage commitment through Pax5.
final_rationale: SIRT7 deacetylates Pax5 K198, sustains Pax5 protein stability, and proteasome inhibition reverses Pax5 loss.

title: IGF2BP2 Maintains Retinal Pigment Epithelium Homeostasis by Stabilizing PAX6 and OTX2.
final_rationale: IGF2BP2 stabilizes PAX6 and OTX2 mRNAs through m6A-reader activity; useful comparator for abundance control but RNA-level rather than PAX protein turnover.

title: SUMO-specific protease 1 regulates germinal center B cell response through deSUMOylation of PAX5.
final_rationale: SENP1 deSUMOylates PAX5 and maintains PAX5 protein level during germinal center B-cell responses.

title: The ups and downs of Pax6 in neural stem cells.
final_rationale: Review/commentary summarizes Kat2a acetylation of Pax6 leading to RNF8 ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation.

title: Histone acetyltransferase KAT2A modulates neural stem cell differentiation and proliferation by inducing degradation of the transcription factor PAX6.
final_rationale: KAT2A acetylates PAX6 and facilitates RNF8-mediated ubiquitination and degradation, influencing neural stem cell differentiation.

title: PHD3 inhibits cell proliferation through hydroxylation of PAX2 at proline 9.
final_rationale: PHD3 hydroxylates PAX2 at proline 9 and links this post-translational modification to growth inhibition.

title: c-Abl Kinase Is Required for Satellite Cell Function Through Pax7 Regulation.
final_rationale: c-Abl interacts with and phosphorylates Pax7; the paper places Pax7 in a post-translational regulation framework including ubiquitin-proteasome turnover.

title: 17-DMAG dually inhibits Hsp90 and histone lysine demethylases in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.
final_rationale: PAX3-FOXO1 behaves as an Hsp90 client and is destabilized/degraded by geldanamycin and 17-DMAG.

title: PAX6, modified by SUMOylation, plays a protective role in corneal endothelial injury.
final_rationale: PAX6 SUMOylation is tested in corneal endothelial cells; useful comparator for PAX-family SUMO modification but less directly tied to degradation.

title: Ck2-Dependent Phosphorylation Is Required to Maintain Pax7 Protein Levels in Proliferating Muscle Progenitors.
final_rationale: CK2-dependent Pax7 phosphorylation maintains Pax7 protein levels by preventing ubiquitin-proteasome downregulation.

title: NEDD4 Regulates PAX7 Levels Promoting Activation of the Differentiation Program in Skeletal Muscle Precursors.
final_rationale: NEDD4 ubiquitin ligase regulates Pax7 levels; proteasome inhibition and ubiquitination assays support turnover control.

title: Small molecule inhibition of PAX3-FOXO1 through AKT activation suppresses malignant phenotypes of alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.
final_rationale: Thapsigargin activates AKT, phosphorylates PAX3-FOXO1, inhibits transcriptional activity, and promotes proteasomal degradation.

title: Taf1 regulates Pax3 protein by monoubiquitination in skeletal muscle progenitors.
final_rationale: Taf1 mediates Pax3 monoubiquitination, enabling proteasomal degradation during skeletal muscle progenitor differentiation.

title: Using protein design algorithms to understand the molecular basis of disease caused by protein-DNA interactions: the Pax6 example.
final_rationale: Protein design analysis predicts many PAX6 paired-domain mutations impair protein stability or protein-DNA binding energy.

title: Papillorenal syndrome-causing missense mutations in PAX2/Pax2 result in hypomorphic alleles in mouse and human.
final_rationale: PAX2 missense variants are hypomorphic and include functional defects relevant to PAX-family protein localization/activity interpretation.
